free_tier.stated: none: the public API was permanently shut down on November 15, 2015; the hosted API is sold on RapidAPI from the Basic plan at USD 7.00 a month for 1,000 requests a day
free_tier.notes: Pro is USD 22.00 a month for 5,000 requests a day, Ultra USD 50.00 for 20,000 and Mega USD 100.00 for 100,000; each plan adds a per-request price past its daily count and a bandwidth fee past 10240 MB a month.

per_object_cap.stated: one IP address per request (Location with specific IP)

egress.terms: RapidAPI plans include a bandwidth allowance of 10240 MB a month, then USD 0.001 per 1 MB
egress.free_allowance: 10240 MB a month on every paid plan

interface_detail: RapidAPI endpoints Legacy - GeoIP, JSON IP, IP, Location and Location with specific IP; the project site documents /ip, /jsonip and /geoip/{ip} with JSON and JSONP answers
tooling: any HTTP client through a RapidAPI subscription; the open-source Go server over MaxMind GeoLite2 databases is the last resort, which the user installs and runs on a rented or free machine
chaining: No free hosted route exists. Hosted first: the paid RapidAPI plans from USD 7.00 a month, or any free keyless or free-key API of this topic. Last resort: the open-source server. Bulk path: none.

limits.value: Basic: 1,000 requests a day, then USD 0.0005 a request; Pro 5,000, Ultra 20,000, Mega 100,000 a day

binding_note: there is no free allowance; the lowest paid plan counts 1,000 requests a day.

identity_cost.detail: a RapidAPI account and a paid subscription; the payment form of RapidAPI was not read

reliability_note: the public API has been shut down since 2015-11-15; the project site still serves its documentation, and the hosted API is reached only through paid RapidAPI plans
confidence_note: The project site, the RapidAPI listing and pricing page and the repository README were quoted on 2026-11-02; no paid subscription was made and the RapidAPI payment step was not read.
